name: Curry County, NM
findings: Curry County has 105 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Curry County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
